tables.title: Effect size (95% exact interval)
rows: Share of changes that go 0 to 1
Odds ratio of change (0 to 1 / 1 to 0)

diagnostics: number of successes = 5, number of trials = 5, p-value = 0.0625
alternative hypothesis: true probability of success is not equal to 0.5
notes: Exact two-sided binomial test of the discordant pairs: under no change, moves 0 to 1 and 1 to 0 are equally likely. The odds ratio is the conditional odds ratio of matched pairs (as Stata mcc reports); its interval is the exact Clopper-Pearson interval for the share, transformed.
